Pose - Selfie Shot.description:
🕴️ Pose: Selfie Shot
Holding a device at arm's length for a self-portrait — modern, casual, and slightly playful.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Selfie Shot.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, use a casual near-camera pose with one arm extended toward the viewer and the face oriented toward an implied lens. Show a phone or camera only when another selected visual trait explicitly defines it; otherwise keep the extended hand empty. Do not tighten the crop. Female: the near shoulder drops toward the lens. Male: the near shoulder holds square toward the lens. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own near-camera line.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
